text.en:
Subsection (i) of section twelve hundred and three of the Administrative Code is hereby
amended to read as follows:
" (i) Every steamer making round trips in not more than forty-eight hours, staying all night in port, shall have
the following complement of engineers:
"Up to one hundred and twenty horsepower, one fourth engineer.
"From one hundred and twenty-one horsepower upward, one third and one fourth engineer."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 6, 1924.
